hero.eyebrow: Prakritik Paint · Made from cow dung
hero.subheadline: Cow dung-based Prakritik Paint in distemper and emulsion formats for interior and exterior walls. Naturally breathable, naturally Indian.

story.lead: Gaurikrit Bio Products began at a gaushala, where cow dung was abundant and purpose was scarce.
story.body:
Every year, thousands of tonnes of cow dung go unused — a material that Indian homes have used on walls for centuries. We set out to turn it back into paint.

Prakritik Paint is made by cleaning, drying, and refining cow dung into a fine natural binder, then blending it with lime, plant pigments, and minerals. The result is a paint that breathes with your walls, contains no lead or VOC-heavy solvents, and carries the warmth of an Indian courtyard.
story.founderQuote: We did not invent this. Our grandmothers did. We only made it consistent.
